summary: Russia localization of Business Central 29. It adds Russian accounting and tax functionality: VAT ledgers and settlement, G/L correspondence, prepayment differences, fixed assets, cash and bank orders, tax registers, and statutory print forms (TORG, M-, FA-, CO- series). It answers what Russia-specific setup, posting and reports exist.
overview:
The Russian layer is large: 879 objects, of which 659 are new (including 140 reports, 268 pages, 151 tables and 73 codeunits) and 220 replace W1 objects, with 1145 fields and 427 procedures added. Core posting objects such as Gen. Jnl.-Post Line, Purch.-Post, Sales-Post, Item Jnl.-Post Line and the fixed asset posting codeunits are extended with Russian procedures. VAT Entry, VAT Posting Setup, Currency, Customer, Vendor and the journal and ledger tables receive many local fields.

New functionality sits mainly in its own codeunits and pages: VAT prepayment, allocation, settlement, reinstatement, ledgers and the VAT invoice journal (codeunits 12410, 12411, 12417, 12418, 12423, 12424), G/L correspondence (12402, 12404), prepayment differences (12412), agreements (12421), corrective documents (12422), fixed asset documents (12470 to 12472), customs declaration tracking (14100 series), tax registers (17200 series), tax differences (17300 series) and statutory reports (26550). Excel report helper codeunits in the 14930 to 14955 range produce forms such as Factura-Invoice, TORG-12, TORG-13, TORG-16, TORG-29, M-4, M-11, M-15, INV-17, INV-18, FA-1, FA-2, FA-3, FA-4, FA-14, FA-15, cash orders and bank payment orders.

Microsoft Learn documents this under "Russia local functionality" with pages on fixed assets, VAT ledgers, prepayments, petty cash and bank management, inventory documents and red storno, financial reports, tax registers and tax differences, customs declarations, and HR and payroll topics.
key_points: VAT: VAT ledgers (sales, purchase, additional sheets), VAT settlement and reinstatement journals, vendor VAT invoice registration, and VAT agent fields on Vendor; VAT Posting Setup gains transit VAT, settlement template and tax invoice amount type fields.
G/L correspondence: correspondence entries, analysis and turnover pages for accounts, customers, vendors and items, with an Automatic G/L Correspondence option in General Ledger Setup.
Prepayments and prepayment differences: prepayment accounts on posting groups, Prepmt. Diff. fields on ledger entries, and per-entry exchange rate adjustment when Russian accounting is enabled.
Fixed assets: FA documents for release, movement and write-off, locations and responsible employees, depreciation bonus, assessed tax, FA charges, inventory, and tax depreciation books.
Bank and cash: bank directory with BIC, bank payment orders, cash account cards, ingoing and outgoing cash orders, and reports CO-3 and CO-4.
Inventory and documents: red storno posting, item documents, TORG-12, TORG-13, TORG-16, TORG-29, M-4, M-11, INV-17 and Factura-Invoice forms exported to Excel through template codes in setup tables.
Tax accounting and reporting: tax registers, tax difference journals, financial report extensions and constants on account schedules, and statutory report management.
Customs declaration (CD) tracking on items, packages and warehouse lines, plus corrective documents and agreements on sales and purchase documents.

areas.what: Holds most of the Russian layer as own objects: VAT ledger, settlement and reinstatement codeunits, G/L correspondence, prepayment differences, agreements, corrective documents, FA documents, customs declaration tracking, tax registers, tax differences and statutory reports. Also adds hundreds of pages and reports, including Excel report helpers for local print forms.
areas.why: Learn documents these as VAT ledgers, G/L correspondence, tax registers, tax differences and the Russian print forms.

areas.what: Extends general ledger posting with Russian VAT, prepayment and tax difference handling. Adds many fields to Gen. Journal Line, VAT Entry, Currency, General Ledger Setup, VAT Posting Setup and G/L Account. Adds journal batch VAT settlement and reinstatement, per-entry exchange rate adjustment and reversal logic.
areas.why: Learn describes VAT Posting Setup fields, VAT settlement, prepayment differences and exchange rate adjustment per entry under Russian accounting.

areas.what: Adds Russian fixed asset features: inventory number, depreciation group, status, FA locations and employees, depreciation bonus, tax depreciation books, FA charges and disposal results. Extends FA posting, depreciation and reclassification codeunits.
areas.why: Learn covers release, movement, write-off, depreciation bonus, assessed tax and disposal expense accounting for fixed assets.

areas.what: Adds employee purchases (advance statements), corrective documents, prepayment difference fields, agreement numbers and vendor VAT invoice data to purchase documents and ledgers. Vendor and Vendor Bank Account get Russian codes (OKPO, BIC) and VAT agent fields; Suggest Vendor Payments supports VAT agent payments.
areas.why: Learn documents vendor VAT invoice registration, vendor prepayments, and VAT agent handling.

areas.what: Adds corrective documents with before and after line values, prepayment and agreement fields, act signer data and KPP/OKPO codes to sales documents and customer tables. Sales-Post gains procedures for corrective documents and prepayment difference documents.
areas.why: Learn documents customer prepayments, prepayment differences and the shipment documents printed from sales.

areas.what: Adds red storno posting, links between items and fixed assets, prepayment difference accounts on inventory posting groups, and many local template codes in Inventory Setup. Item journal, value entry and posting codeunits are extended.
areas.why: Learn documents red storno corrections, inventory setup and item documents.

areas.what: Extends Company Information with Russian codes and officials, Source Code Setup with local source codes, Country/Region with local names and EAEU codes, and Unit of Measure with an OKEI code. Document printing and report selection get local print procedures.
areas.why: Learn covers currency and company information setup and report selection for local print forms.

areas.what: Adds bank BIC, correspondent account and cash account fields to Bank Account, plus Russian payer and recipient details on bank reconciliation lines, check ledger entries and payment export data. Supports bank payment orders and cash orders.
areas.why: Learn documents bank payment orders, cash account cards and petty cash management.

areas.what: Extends several W1 permission sets (LOCAL, LOCAL READ, fixed assets, vendor and customer sets) to cover the Russian objects.
Adds fields and procedures to data exchange definitions, Excel Buffer and generic CSV import and export, for example column type and name, document start and end tags, and header or footer skipping.
Extends Employee with an employee vendor link, bank code, identity document, short name and helper procedures such as full name and age. Employee List and Misc. Article also get local changes.
Adds data classification for Russian tables and a procedure to move G/L correspondence entries.
Adds a CD No. field for customs declaration tracking to warehouse activity lines and bin content buffer.
areas.why: Learn describes customs declaration tracking on goods.

areas.what: Adds a page extension for report selection for production orders.

issues: Overview says about 640 new objects; the input lists 659 own objects (659 added plus 220 replaced makes the 879 total).
Overview says 'FA-1 to FA-15', which suggests a full series. The input only has helpers for FA-1, FA-2, FA-3, FA-4, FA-14 and FA-15.

The 'codeunits 12410 to 12424' range for VAT also covers codeunits that are not about VAT (Excel Management, Doc. Signature Management, Agreement Management, EmployeeVendor-Update). The VAT ones are 12410, 12411, 12417, 12418, 12423 and 12424.
The '14930 to 14955' range for Excel report helpers includes 14940 and 14941, which handle G/L correspondence analysis views, not reports.
